definition.name: Synthesizer
definition.description:
Converts matters by transmuting one resource into another. This allows transformations such as Florinol into Aurixite.

Consumes {amount} Energy per conversion.

definition.name: Burner Belt
definition.description: Moves elements at regular belt speed. Ignites flammable materials above when fueled by an adjacent Thermal Buffer. Without heat, acts as a normal belt.

definition.name: Clearing Frame
definition.description: Moves elements inside.

definition.name: Conveyor Belt Mk.2
definition.description: Moves elements faster.

definition.name: Copper Mold
definition.description:
A mold that only accepts Liquid Copper. When filled, it transforms into a solid Power Brick that can be used to store Energy.

The Power Brick can be charged by transferring Energy from a Florinol Battery using an Energy Siphon, or by connecting it to a Steam Turbine.

definition.name: Critter Fence
definition.description: A barrier that lets every element pass through but keeps critters from crossing.

definition.name: Earth Stratacore
definition.description: Slowly generates and reinforces Earth Strataform. Only one can be placed at a time.

definition.name: Energy Connector
definition.description:
A passive conductor that bridges power structures so Energy can flow between them. For example, connecting a Steam Turbine to a Power Brick network.

Stores no Energy itself.

definition.name: Advanced Filter
definition.description: Filters multiple element types at once, including liquids and gases.

definition.name: Advanced Filter
definition.description: Filters multiple element types at once, including liquids and gases.

definition.name: Filter Wall
definition.description: Filters elements based on filter settings without acting as a conveyor.

definition.name: Advanced Filter Wall
definition.description: Filters multiple element types at once, including liquids and gases, without acting as a conveyor.

definition.name: Glass Foundation
definition.description: A transparent glass foundation.

definition.name: Florinol Battery
definition.description:
Putting Florinol in a battery generates and stores Energy.

When used up, it hardens and can be destroyed or burned to recycle back into Energy.

definition.name: Pyro Dispenser
definition.description: Fires a flame burst every {seconds} seconds in the direction it was placed. Each shot consumes heat from an adjacent Thermal Buffer.

definition.name: Launcher Mk.2
definition.description: Launches elements faster.

definition.name: Prismaline Well
definition.description:
Drains the Prismaline buffer and emits Prismaline above at a fixed rate. Must be built just outside the disk of the Aura Extractor.

Its purpose remains unknown... for now.

definition.name: Prismite Well
definition.description:
Drains the Prismite buffer and emits Prismite below at a fixed rate. Must be built just outside the disk of the Aura Extractor.

Its purpose remains unknown... for now.

definition.name: Conveyor Portal
definition.description: A linked pair of short-range portals used to move elements across gaps or over other conveyor belt lines.

definition.name: Retro Console
definition.description: A playable gaming console. Place it and use Game Controller to play by hovering the console and pressing the arrow keys.

definition.name: Infinite Source
definition.description: Creates an endless stream of the configured element.

definition.name: Trash
definition.description: An infinitely deep void for particle trash.

definition.name: AND Gate
definition.description: Outputs On only if all inputs are On.

definition.name: Buffer
definition.description: Forwards its input unchanged.

definition.name: Signal Button
definition.description: Press to pulse a linked signal.

definition.name: Door
definition.description: Door that can be toggled by pressing or via sensor signals.

definition.name: Signal Lamp
definition.description: Indicator that lights up when its linked signal is On.

definition.name: NAND Gate
definition.description: Outputs On unless all inputs are On.

definition.name: NOR Gate
definition.description: Outputs On only if all inputs are Off.

definition.name: NOT Gate
definition.description: Outputs the inverse of a single input (requires exactly 1 input).

definition.name: OR Gate
definition.description: Outputs On if any input is On.

definition.name: Presence Sensor
definition.description: Emits a signal while at least one element is inside its 4x4 area.

definition.name: Pulse Sensor
definition.description: Emits a short On pulse when its 4x4 area becomes full.

definition.name: Repeater
definition.description: Delays signal by one tick.

definition.name: Signal Sensor
definition.description: Emits a signal when its 4x4 area is full of elements.

definition.name: Signal Switch
definition.description: Press to toggle a linked signal.

definition.name: Toggle (T-FlipFlop)
definition.description: Memory bit. Toggles On/Off on each input pulse (rising edge).

definition.name: XNOR Gate
definition.description: Outputs On if an even number of inputs are On.

definition.name: XOR Gate
definition.description: Outputs On if an odd number of inputs are On.

definition.name: Smelter
definition.description: Periodically smelts resources placed on top into liquid form. Uses heat from an adjacent Thermal Buffer or Lava.

definition.name: Snowmaker
definition.description: Consumes Water above and {amount} Energy to spawn Snow below.

definition.name: Steam Turbine
definition.description:
Generates energy when Steam passes through the turbine.

Connect it directly to a Power Brick (a Copper Mold filled with Liquid Copper) to store the Energy.

definition.name: Aura Extractor
definition.description: Creates the Aura Extractor. Press the placed structure to command the swarm.

definition.name: Thermal Buffer
definition.description:
Stores and exchanges heat. Charge it with the Flamethrower, or let it consume adjacent Lava / Snow. Connected buffers equalize temperature.

Hover with the Grabber to see temperature.

definition.name: Steam Dryer
definition.description: Converts Amethelis into Dry Amethelis when put on top, using Steam below as fuel.

definition.name: Condenser
definition.description: Condenses adjacent gases into their liquid forms (e.g. Florin into Florinol). Uses cold from an adjacent Thermal Buffer or Snow above.

definition.name: Void Rift
definition.description: Opens a mysterious rift that produces Void Seed from the depths of space.
